20261118-math-g05.topic: Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso
20261118-math-g05.goal: Sebenzisa izimiso ze-Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso ukuxazulula inkinga yophenyo.
20261118-math-g05.material: [E5 Uphenyo Lwezibalo] Umbuzo wophenyo mayelana ne-Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso. Izinombolo zemvelo ezimbili u-$A$ no-$B$ zanelisa $A + 2B = 24$. Lapho u-$A$ ethatha inani eliphakeme kakhulu, liyini inani lika-$B$?
20261118-math-g05.thinking.0: Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso
20261118-math-g05.s.s1.prompt: [E5 Uphenyo Lwezibalo] Umbuzo wophenyo mayelana ne-Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso. Izinombolo zemvelo ezimbili u-$A$ no-$B$ zanelisa $A + 2B = 24$. Lapho u-$A$ ethatha inani eliphakeme kakhulu, liyini inani lika-$B$?
20261118-math-g05.s.s1.explain:
Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlela kabusha isibalo kunikeza u-$A = 24 - 2B$.
Isinyathelo 2: Njengoba u-$A, B \ge 1$ kuyizinombolo zemvelo, u-$2B$ kufanele abe mncane kakhulu ukuze u-$A$ abe mkhulu.
Isinyathelo 3: Inombolo yemvelo encane kakhulu ngu-$B = 1$.
Isinyathelo 4: Kuleli qophelo, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (ubukhulu), ngakho-ke $B = 1$.
20261118-math-g05.s.s1.hint.0: Inani elincane lenombolo yemvelo lika-$B$ ngu-$1$.
20261118-math-g05.s.s1.hint.1: Njengoba $A = 24 - 2B$, u-$A$ uba mkhulu lapho u-$B$ emncane kakhulu.

20261119-math-g05-2.material: [E5 Uphenyo Lwezibalo (Okuthuthukile)] Inkinga yophenyo eyinkimbinkimbi usebenzisa i-Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso. Isamba sezinombolo zemvelo ezintathu ezilandelanayo singu-$3S$, kanti umkhiqizo wenkulu nencane kuhlanganiswe no-$1$ ulingana no-$T^2$. Lapho u-$S = 15$, iyiphi inombolo enkulu kunazo zonke?
20261119-math-g05-2.thinking.0: Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso
20261119-math-g05-2.s.s1.prompt: [E5 Uphenyo Lwezibalo (Okuthuthukile)] Inkinga yophenyo eyinkimbinkimbi usebenzisa i-Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso. Isamba sezinombolo zemvelo ezintathu ezilandelanayo singu-$3S$, kanti umkhiqizo wenkulu nencane kuhlanganiswe no-$1$ ulingana no-$T^2$. Lapho u-$S = 15$, iyiphi inombolo enkulu kunazo zonke?
20261119-math-g05-2.s.s1.explain:
Isinyathelo 1: Ukuthatha izinombolo njengo-$n-1, n, n+1$, isamba siba ngu-$3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.
Isinyathelo 2: Izinombolo ezintathu ngu-$14, 15, 16$.
Isinyathelo 3: Inombolo enkulu kunazo zonke ngu-$16$.
Isinyathelo 4: Ukuqinisekisa: $(14 \times 16) + 1 = 224 + 1 = 225 = 15^2$.
20261119-math-g05-2.s.s1.hint.0: Ukuthatha izinombolo ezilandelanayo njengo-$n-1, n, n+1$ kunikeza isamba esingu-$3n$.

20261125-math-g05-1.goal: Sebenzisa izimiso ze-Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso ukuxazulula inkinga yophenyo.
20261125-math-g05-1.material: [E5 Uphenyo Lwezibalo] Umbuzo wophenyo mayelana ne-Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso. Izinombolo zemvelo ezimbili u-$A$ no-$B$ zanelisa $A + 2B = 24$. Lapho u-$A$ ethatha inani eliphakeme kakhulu, liyini inani lika-$B$?
20261125-math-g05-1.thinking.0: Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso
20261125-math-g05-1.s.s1.prompt: [E5 Uphenyo Lwezibalo] Umbuzo wophenyo mayelana ne-Izingxenyana, amadesimali, izihlukanisi nokuphindwa, indawo nevolumu, izilinganiso. Izinombolo zemvelo ezimbili u-$A$ no-$B$ zanelisa $A + 2B = 24$. Lapho u-$A$ ethatha inani eliphakeme kakhulu, liyini inani lika-$B$?
20261125-math-g05-1.s.s1.explain:
Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlela kabusha isibalo kunikeza u-$A = 24 - 2B$.
Isinyathelo 2: Njengoba u-$A, B \ge 1$ kuyizinombolo zemvelo, u-$2B$ kufanele abe mncane kakhulu ukuze u-$A$ abe mkhulu.
Isinyathelo 3: Inombolo yemvelo encane kakhulu ngu-$B = 1$.
Isinyathelo 4: Kuleli qophelo, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (ubukhulu), ngakho-ke $B = 1$.
